title: Relative Invariant Forgetting
statement: For $R$, a profinite residual group $G$ and a topological group $J$, define $U$_$J$ by restriction to (1,$J$) and $U$_0 by full forgetting of $G$. The unique invariant-functor isomorphism Gamma_$J$^$G$ $U$_0 = $U$_$J$ Gamma_$J$ is fixed by equality of the actual invariant inclusions. Its ordinary derived isomorphism RGamma_$J$^$G$ D($U$_0) = D($U$_$J$) RGamma_$J$ is fixed by the computation-unit equation on EVERY complex. It commutes with canonical shifts. For every continuous v:$J$ to $H$, define the identity-underlying commutation isomorphism between $U$_$H$ followed by v-restriction and (id_$G$,v)-restriction followed by $U$_$J$, and its canonical derived localization comparison. Under these identifications, forgetting beta equals the recorded scalar derived restriction map as an actual derived arrow. Define forgottenLambda by applying $U$_0 to lambda and these exact-functor localization identifications. Define adding a trivial residual action by projection restriction, its unique identity-underlying forgetting isomorphism, and its termwise comparison on bounded-below scalar action complexes. Uses [def-sfb-relative-derived-invariants], [def-sfb-relative-cyclic-total], [lem-sfb-condensed-derived-restriction-calculus].

proof.text: Identify kernel-fixed sections with all fixed sections after restriction to the second factor, using g=(1,snd g) whenever fst g=1. Transpose the relative invariant inclusion through the scalar invariants adjunction. The two fixed-section image descriptions make this transpose bijective on every profinite section. Forgetting to underlying sheaves reflects isomorphisms. Injectivity of the scalar inclusion proves naturality and uniqueness. This proves forgetInvariantsExist without a new hole.

For the derived comparison use [lem-sfb-relative-forgetting-kinjectives]. Construct both units for the underived common composite, inserting the actual exact-localization factors and the underived forgetting isomorphism. They are isomorphisms on K-injective complexes, so the K-injective derivability structure makes both functors right derived functors. Their unique unit-compatible comparison gives existence. Cancel the source unit on a K-injective representative and the target localization factor to prove uniqueness, then extend along the representative isomorphism. This proves forgetDerivedExist with precisely the original normalization equation.

Restriction along v after inclusion of the second factor is the same action as product restriction followed by inclusion. Projection onto the second factor after that inclusion is the identity. In both cases use componentwise identity isomorphisms; equality of underlying maps gives naturality and uniqueness. This proves forgetRestrictionExist and unitResidualIsoExist.

Remaining original holes: forgetBeta identifies the two restriction composites through their computation-unit equations and inclusion normalizations. forgetDerivedShift identifies the shift conjugate of the comparison by its same unit normalization. These two named theorems and their original docstring proof plans remain unchanged.
